Articles

Get started

HeatmapR

Guides

Deeper looks at what HeatmapR can do, with every figure drawn as the site is built.

Building heatmaps in the browser

heat_map_app() builds heatmaps, dot plots and correlation heatmaps from a file or from data in R without writing code, and writes the R code that draws them again.

Ordering rows and columns

Dendrogram, optimal leaf and spectral orders, how they work and when to use each, measured on clusters, a trajectory and a cycle.

Large heatmaps

Hundreds of thousands of rows: raster drawing, two-stage clustering, k-means splits, automatic cuts, labels and zoom panels, threads and memory.

More than colour

Uncertainty, two values in a cell, distributions inside cells and beside the heatmap, metadata annotations, honest colour scales and correlations.

Working with heatmaps

Redrawing and saving heatmaps, extracting their orders and clusters, tidy data for ggplot2, heatmaps beside ggplot2 plots and alternative text for screen readers.

Single-cell data

Heatmaps, dot plots, markers, conditions, cytometry and trajectories of single-cell data, read from SingleCellExperiment and Seurat objects, AnnData files and cytometry files.

Single-cell data

Start here: the single-cell objects and files HeatmapR reads, heatmaps of cells, summaries of groups, the Seurat and scanpy functions each function stands in for, and how fast they are.

Markers, dot plots and gene sets

Rank the markers of each cluster or cell type, draw them as heatmaps and dot plots, score cells for sets of genes, put genes beside scores or proteins, and find clusters that may be two populations.

Samples and conditions

Compare conditions in single-cell data with the samples as replicates: the make-up of each sample, pseudobulk tests of each cell type, and dot plots, split cells and panels on shared scales that show the changes.

Cytometry

Flow and mass cytometry events: reading flowFrame and flowSet objects, the asinh transform and quantile scaling, heatmaps of events and of cluster medians, abundances, differential states, and clusters that may be two populations.

Trajectories

Genes along pseudotime: cells in order, genes smoothed over bins and ordered by when they peak, modules of genes, lineages side by side, and cells ordered without a pseudotime.

Performance

Speed comparison

The time and memory HeatmapR, ComplexHeatmap, pheatmap, gplots, stats and ggplot2 need to draw and cluster heatmaps from 10,000 to 9 million cells, and of clustering and leaf ordering on their own.
